tok 1.0 "Service degradation handling"

pool teleco "TELECO and customer"
  lane customer "Customer"
    start perceived "Service degradation perceived"
    task sendlist "Send the list of problem parameters"
    task receivereport "Receive the report"
    end custdone "Customer process ended"
  lane cs "Customer Service"
    task enter "Enter the problem report into system T"
    task compare "Compare the problem report to the customer SLA"
    task measures "Determine the counter measures and priorities"
    xor premium "Customer premium?"
    call extrafix "Run the extra problem fix process" process=extrafix
    xor premiumjoin
    xor affects "Significance affects counter measures?"
    task detailed "Create the detailed problem report"
    task sendsm "Send the detailed problem report to Service Management"
    xor csmerge
    and csplit
    task custreport "Create the report for the customer"
    task sendcust "Send the report to the customer"
    task rebate "Report the SLA violation rebate"
    and cjoin
    end csdone "Customer Service ended"
  lane esvc "Electronic service"
    task significance "Determine the significance of the customer"
  lane sm "Service Management"
    task investigate "Investigate whether the problem is analyzable"
    xor analyzable "Analyzable by Service Management?"
    task sendrp "Send the detailed problem report to Resource Provisioning"
    task analysis "Perform the analysis"
    task smtrouble "Create the trouble report"
    xor smmerge
    task waitstatus "Receive the status report"
    task finalstatus "Prepare the final status report"
    xor decide "Which counter measures?"
    task sendperf "Send the actual service performance to Customer Service"
    task minor "Undertake corrective actions"
    xor resmerge
    task resolution "Create the problem resolution report"
    task sendres "Send the problem resolution report to Customer Service"
    task request "Create the request for automatic resource restoration"
    task sendreq "Send the restoration request to Resource Provisioning"
    task recvts "Receive the trouble-shooting report"
  lane rp "Resource Provisioning"
    task checkprob "Check for possible problems"
    xor problem "Problem detected?"
    task notification "Create the normal execution notification"
    task rpanalyze "Analyze the problem"
    task rptrouble "Create the trouble report"
    xor rpmerge
    task status "Create the status report"
    task sendstatus "Send the status report to Service Management"
    eventgw hold
    catch restreq "Restoration request received" message="Restoration request"
    catch timeout "2 days passed" timer=P2D
    end terminated "Process terminated" terminate
    task track "Track all possible errors"
    task rpcorrect "Undertake the necessary corrective actions"
    task tsreport "Create the trouble-shooting report"
    task sendts "Send the trouble-shooting report to Service Management"
    end rpdone "Resource Provisioning ended"
  lane bc "Billing & Collections"
    task adjust "Adjust the billing"
